.clip-editor{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:12;display:flex;flex-direction:column;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(#05080bc9,transparent 25%,transparent 48%,#05080bdc 76%);font-family:inherit}
.clip-editor button,.clip-editor select,.clip-editor textarea{font:inherit}.clip-editor button{cursor:pointer}.clip-editor-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px max(22px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) 12px max(22px,env(safe-area-inset-left));background:#0a1019e8;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff28;z-index:1}.clip-editor-header h1{font-size:19px;margin:0}.clip-editor-header button{border:0;border-radius:20px;background:#2b333d;color:#fff;padding:9px 20px;font-size:13px}.clip-editor-header [data-editor-publish]{background:#f4c945;color:#111;font-weight:800}.clip-editor-header button:disabled{opacity:.5}
.clip-editor-preview{flex:1;min-height:80px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px;pointer-events:none}.clip-editor-preview span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-shadow:0 2px 5px #000}.clip-editor-preview button{pointer-events:auto;border:1px solid #ffffffaa;border-radius:30px;background:#0d1621c9;color:#fff;padding:10px 20px;font-size:13px}
.clip-editor-panel{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:18px clamp(16px,5vw,70px) max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));background:#10151cf5;border-top:1px solid #ffffff2d;box-shadow:0 -8px 30px #0008}.clip-editor-times{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:12px;color:#d5d9df;margin-bottom:11px}.clip-editor-times strong{color:#f4c945;font-size:13px}.clip-editor-track{position:relative;height:64px;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair}.clip-editor-filmstrip{position:absolute;inset:7px 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:2px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:5px;background:#27303a}.clip-editor-filmstrip span{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#304359,#172532 65%,#355b67)}.clip-editor-filmstrip span:nth-child(3n){background:linear-gradient(45deg,#485f66,#223b48 65%,#1d2935)}.clip-editor-selection{position:absolute;top:4px;bottom:4px;left:var(--trim-start);right:calc(100% - var(--trim-end));border:3px solid #f4c945;border-radius:4px;pointer-events:none}.clip-editor-handle{position:absolute;top:4px;bottom:4px;width:23px;border:0;background:#f4c945;z-index:2;touch-action:none}.clip-editor-handle.start{left:var(--trim-start);transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:5px 0 0 5px}.clip-editor-handle.end{left:var(--trim-end);transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:0 5px 5px 0}.clip-editor-handle:after{content:'';display:block;width:3px;height:20px;border-radius:3px;background:#6a5615;margin:auto}.clip-editor-playhead{position:absolute;top:-3px;bottom:-3px;left:var(--playhead,var(--trim-start));width:2px;background:white;box-shadow:0 0 5px #000;pointer-events:none}
.clip-editor-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:18px}.clip-editor-options label{display:grid;gap:6px;color:#bec8d0;font-size:11px}.clip-editor-options select,.clip-editor-options textarea{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:39px;border:1px solid #52606b;border-radius:5px;background:#1e2933;color:#fff;padding:7px 10px;font-size:13px}.clip-editor-options .clip-editor-caption{grid-column:1/-1}.clip-editor-options textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:52px}.clip-editor-error{min-height:15px;margin:8px 0 0;color:#ff91a8;font-size:12px}.clip-editor :focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f4c945;outline-offset:2px}

.rumble-control .rumble-use{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:var(--power-size);height:var(--power-size);min-width:0;min-height:0;padding:3px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #b9d9ed66;background:radial-gradient(circle,#092233b0,#07162566 65%,transparent 72%);color:#fff;box-shadow:none;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;overflow:hidden}
.rumble-use:disabled{cursor:default}.rumble-use img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;pointer-events:none}.rumble-use img[hidden]{display:none}
.rumble-use [data-rumble-count]{font-size:clamp(18px,3vh,29px);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.rumble-use [data-rumble-count][hidden]{display:none}
.rumble-control[data-phase=ready] .rumble-use{border-color:transparent;background:transparent;overflow:visible}.rumble-control[data-phase=ready] img{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px var(--power-color))}
.rumble-control[data-ready=true] .rumble-use:active{transform:scale(.94)}
.rumble-readiness{position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 5px);width:140px;font-size:clamp(9px,1.3vh,12px);font-weight:900;color:#7dff9e!important;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #000;pointer-events:none}
.rumble-control[data-ready=false] .rumble-readiness{color:#ffd17a!important}
.rumble-control[data-phase=ready][data-ready=false] .rumble-use{border:1px dashed #ffd17a99;background:#07162566;opacity:.72;filter:none;overflow:hidden}
.rumble-control[data-phase=ready][data-ready=false] img{filter:grayscale(.7);opacity:.65}
.rumble-control[data-phase=ready][data-ready=true] .rumble-key{color:#8bffb0!important;border-color:#8bffb0}
.rumble-target{--aim-color:#7dff9e;position:absolute;z-index:4;width:clamp(36px,6vh,62px);aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;color:var(--aim-color);filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px #000)}
.rumble-target[data-ready=false]{--aim-color:#ffd17a}
.rumble-target-frame{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(var(--aim-color),var(--aim-color)) left top/12px 2px,linear-gradient(var(--aim-color),var(--aim-color)) left top/2px 12px,linear-gradient(var(--aim-color),var(--aim-color)) right top/12px 2px,linear-gradient(var(--aim-color),var(--aim-color)) right top/2px 12px,linear-gradient(var(--aim-color),var(--aim-color)) left bottom/12px 2px,linear-gradient(var(--aim-color),var(--aim-color)) left bottom/2px 12px,linear-gradient(var(--aim-color),var(--aim-color)) right bottom/12px 2px,linear-gradient(var(--aim-color),var(--aim-color)) right bottom/2px 12px;background-repeat:no-repeat}
.rumble-target-arrow{display:none;position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:0;height:0;border-top:7px solid transparent;border-bottom:7px solid transparent;border-left:13px solid var(--aim-color);transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(var(--aim-angle))}
.rumble-target[data-offscreen=true] .rumble-target-frame{display:none}.rumble-target[data-offscreen=true] .rumble-target-arrow{display:block}
.rumble-target-label{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 4px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);max-width:min(160px,24vw);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;background:#041421d9;border-radius:3px;padding:3px 6px;font-size:clamp(9px,1.3vh,12px);font-weight:900;color:var(--aim-color)!important}
.rumble-target[hidden],.rumble-readiness[hidden],.is-replaying .rumble-target{display:none!important}
.rumble-control .rumble-key{font:700 clamp(9px,1.4vh,12px) system-ui;color:#e3f3fc;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #000;border:1px solid #c3dced80;border-radius:4px;padding:0 4px}
.rumble-control[data-phase=spin] img{animation:rumble-reel .13s linear infinite}.rumble-control[data-phase=spin] .rumble-use{border-color:#c3eaff;box-shadow:0 0 9px #7ce4ff55}
@keyframes rumble-reel{from{transform:translateY(-42%);opacity:.4}50%{opacity:1}to{transform:translateY(42%);opacity:.4}}

@media(max-height:500px){.rumble-control{right:calc(3.2% + 110px);bottom:8%}}
@media(max-height:500px) and (max-width:700px){.rumble-control{right:calc(2% + 110px)}}
.touch-controls-enabled .rumble-control .rumble-key{display:none}

(function(root,factory){if(typeof module==='object'&&module.exports)module.exports=factory;else root.TurballTelemetry=factory(root);})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis,function(host){
const apiBase=host.document.querySelector('meta[name="api-base"]')?.content||'http://127.0.0.1:2567';
let collector;try{collector=host.GameDeviceDiagnostics?.(host);}catch{}
const started=host.performance.now();
const query=new URLSearchParams(host.location?.search||'');
let revision=0,inFlight=false;
const state={sessionId:host.crypto.randomUUID(),release:host.document.querySelector('meta[name="game-version"]')?.content||'local',
  portal:query.get('cg')==='true'?'CrazyGames':query.get('pg')==='true'?'Playgama':query.get('yeight')==='true'?'Y8':'Standalone',
  stage:'bootstrap',error:'none',lobbyMs:null,firstPlayMs:null,firstGameMs:null,closed:false,cancelled:false};
const elapsed=()=>Math.min(86400000,Math.max(0,Math.round(host.performance.now()-started)));
function flush(beacon=false){
  if(!collector||inFlight&&!beacon)return;
  const body=JSON.stringify({...state,revision:++revision,elapsedMs:elapsed(),diagnostics:collector.snapshot()});
  const url=apiBase.replace(/\/$/,'')+'/api/v1/diagnostics';
  try{
    if(beacon&&host.navigator.sendBeacon?.(url,new Blob([body],{type:'text/plain'})))return;
    if(inFlight)return;inFlight=true;
    host.fetch(url,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain'},body,keepalive:true,credentials:'omit',...(host.AbortSignal?.timeout?{signal:host.AbortSignal.timeout(10000)}:{})}).catch(()=>{}).finally(()=>{inFlight=false;});
  }catch{inFlight=false;}
}
const diagnostics={
  stage(stage){if(state.stage!==stage){state.stage=stage;flush();}},
  lobby(){state.lobbyMs??=elapsed();state.stage='lobby';flush();},
  request(){state.firstPlayMs??=elapsed();state.cancelled=false;state.stage='preparing';flush();},
  cancel(){if(state.firstGameMs===null){state.cancelled=true;flush();}},
  fail(category){state.error=category;flush();},
  playing(active){collector?.playing(active);if(active&&state.firstGameMs===null){state.firstGameMs=elapsed();state.stage='playing';flush();}}
};
host.addEventListener('error',()=>{if(state.lobbyMs===null)diagnostics.fail('startup');});
host.addEventListener('unhandledrejection',()=>{if(state.lobbyMs===null)diagnostics.fail('startup');});
host.setInterval(()=>flush(),30000);
host.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>{state.closed=true;flush(true);});
host.addEventListener('pageshow',()=>{state.closed=false;flush();});
host.document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(host.document.visibilityState==='hidden')flush(true);});
flush();

return diagnostics;
});
